newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 21.

text.p: Following is the summary of major Sri Lankan political and business stories prepared for Reuters by NewsWatch, Colombo Tel/Fax: 94-1-735182 Internet:lucien@eureka.lk.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
TOP STORIES
UNP MP AND SIX OTHERS KILLED IN EASTERN TRINCOMALEE

Trincomalee District MP Mr. M.E.H. Maharoof of the UNP was killed when suspected Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels attacked his vehicle on the Nilaveli road on Sunday. Five others in the vehicle, including a four-year-old child, also died in the attack.

This is the second assassination of an MP in the Trincomalee area by suspected LTTE rebels this month. Tamil United National Front Arunasalam Thangathurai was killed in a grenade attack on July 5 at a school function (DAILY NEWS, THE ISLAND)
MINES DETECTED IN TRINCOMALEE PORT

Divers found six massive bombs lodged in the sea in the Trincomalee harbour. According to security sources, the finding of these bombs averted a major disaster in the Trincomalee Port. (Lankadeepa, DINAMINA AND DIVAINA)
DINAMINA
Sri Lanka troops kill 30 rebels in ambush

A regiment from Weli Oya military headquarters, proceeding northwards to give support to the "Operation Jaya Sikurui" forces in the Wanni ambushed Tigers travelling in a tractor and killed 30 of them.
LANKADEEPA
WALPITAGAMA TO SUCCEED MAHAROOF

Ariyapala Walpitagama is likely to be appointed to the Parliamentary seat which has fallen vacant due to the death of UNP MP M.E.H. Maharoof. UNP sources said that Walpitagama had polled the highest number of preference votes in the last Parliamentary elections after Maharoof.
THINAKKURAL
AUSTRALIAN FOREIGN MINISTER TO DISCUSS WITH TAMIL PARTIES

The Australian Foreign Secretary Alexander Downer, who is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka this week, is expected to meet the Minister of Constitutional Affairs Prof. G. L. Peiris, Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar, representatives of the main opposition United National Party and leaders of Tamil and Moslem political parties.
DINAMINA
Iranian health minister in Sri Lanka

The Iranian Minister of Health and Medical Education Dr. Seyed Al Riza Marand arrived in colombo on July 17 on an invitation by the Sri Lankan Minister of Health Nimal Siripala de Silva. The two ministers discussed possible trade of pharmaceutical products between the two countries among other things.
BUSINESS
DIVAINA
Minister stops unloading of imported tea

The Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs and Plantation Industries Ratnasiri Wickremanayake directed the customs authorities not to allow the unloading of tea imported by a private company.
THINAKARAN AND DINAMINA
Marketing facilities for Jaffna products

Action has been taken to provide facilities to market Jaffna products outside the peninsula, transport them out of Jaffna and to expedite reconstruction activities in the north on a directive by President Chandrika Bandaranaike Kumaratunge.
